cohort: The study enrolled nine pregnancies prenatally diagnosed with fetal atrial appendage aneurysm (AAA) who were evaluated after delivery.
finding: The study found an incidence of fetal AAA of 0.46%, with right AAA being most common (77.8%), and reported associated cardiac anomalies (44.4%), pericardial effusion (22.2%), nonimmune hydrops fetalis (11.1%), neonatal deaths (22.2%), and fetal deaths (11.1%).
followup_time: Into the neonatal period (duration not specified)
gest_age: Average gestational age at delivery was 34.7 +- 4.9 weeks
